title: Equation-of-state experiment settings
description: Public settings for a controlled sound-speed deformation experiment. Omitting matter_model retains the legacy BSk24 contract; CFL configurations declare matter_model explicitly. Runtime semantic validation remains authoritative.

$schema.description: Required editor annotation; it is removed before scientific settings are normalized and hashed.

matter_model.description: Matter model discriminator. The legacy default is BSk24; CFL configurations must declare cfl explicitly.

amplitudes.description: Finite additive amplitudes applied to dimensionless c_s^2. A logical zero-amplitude identity case is added per geometry when absent; one deterministic geometry owns the shared physical baseline execution.

epsilon_match.description: Model-specific reconstruction anchor. BSk24 uses standard or a governed total-energy-density anchor; CFL uses the undeformed zero-pressure self-bound surface.

center.description: Gaussian center or centers in total energy density.

width.description: Gaussian standard deviation or deviations in total energy density.

ramp_width.description: Width or widths of the quintic smootherstep rise from the reconstruction anchor.

calculation.description: Run thermodynamic construction only, or include the governed background, fixed-mass, and tidal stellar calculations.

precision.description: Named governed numerical profile. The expanded internal settings are planned, hashed, and saved.

fixed_masses.description: Requested fixed gravitational masses for stellar calculations.

diagnostics.description: When on, retain the governed endpoint extended stellar diagnostics.
